column19: towards the end of the cave with encrusting sponges and Dendrodoa grossularia forming the main rock cover. Pomatoceros triqueter and spirorbids encrusting the rock
column20: with Ophiopholis aculeata in crevices. A sparse scattering of hydroids included Tubularia indivisa and Kirkenpaureia pinnata. Generally
column21: all very low-lying encrusting sponges.
